spans.s: má-t, ab. (of aham) from me: ˚— used 🞄as the base of aham.
mataṅg-in-ī, f. N. of a daughter of 🞄Mandara.
mata-bheda, m. difference of opinion, 🞄between (g. and in. with saha).

matall-ikā, f. —˚ paragon of a, 🞄splendid, excellent;
 -ī, f. id..

mata‿akṣa, a. skilled in dice;
 -anujñā, f. admission of a fallacy in oneʼs own 🞄reasoning while insisting on a similar one in 🞄that of oneʼs opponent.
matī-kṛ, harrow.
mat-ka, a. my.

mat-kuṇa, m. bug;
 tuskless elephant: 🞄-tva, n. condition of a bug or of a tuskless 🞄elephant.
mát-kṛta, pp. done by me.
mat-tás, ad. = ab. मत् mát.
matyâ, n. harrow or roller.
mát-sakhi, m. (nm. ā) my friend or 🞄companion (RV.¹).
mats-ī, f. female fish (= matsyā).
mātsyá, a. relating or belonging to, 🞄derived from fish.

matsyaṇḍ-ikā, f. boiled down 🞄juice of the sugar-cane;
 -ī, f. id..
mātal-i, m. N. of Indraʼs charioteer: 🞄-sārathi, m. (having Mātali for his charioteer), 🞄ep. of Indra.

mā́tal-in, m. (only nm. -i;
 suffix 🞄-in is otherwise almost invariably accented) 🞄N. of a divine being abiding with Yama 🞄and the Fathers.
mātur-a = mātṛ, —˚ in some a. cpds. 🞄formed with vṛddhi.

mātul-a, m. motherʼs brother, (maternal) 🞄uncle (in fables the ass and the jackal 🞄speak of each other thus): -ka, m. id. (but 🞄more affectionate) dear uncle (in the fable 🞄the crane is called the uncle of the crab).
mātul-ānī, f. wife of a maternal 🞄uncle.

mātuluṅga, m. citron tree;
 n. citron.

mātul-eya, m. son of a maternal 🞄uncle, first cousin;
 -ya, n. (?) house of a 🞄maternal uncle.
2. mā́-tṛ, m. measurer (RV.).
mātrī-ya, den. P. consider or treat 🞄as a mother.
